title: 選舉
summary: Campaign trucks, going home to vote, and counting night.
paragraphs: 在臺灣，每四年會舉行一次總統大選。
選舉前幾個月，街上到處都是候選人的看板和旗子，宣傳車也會在大街小巷廣播。
許多年輕人特地從外地回到戶籍地投票，因為臺灣目前還沒有不在籍投票的制度。
投票當天，選民拿著身分證和印章到投票所，在選票上蓋章。
晚上開票的時候，大家守在電視機前面，關心最新的票數。
不管結果如何，和平地完成選舉，正是民主社會的重要價值。
translation: In Taiwan, a presidential election is held every four years.
For months beforehand, candidates' billboards and flags are everywhere, and campaign trucks broadcast through the streets.
Many young people travel back to where their household is registered to vote, since Taiwan has no absentee voting yet.
On election day, voters bring their ID card and personal seal to the polling station and stamp the ballot.
When votes are counted that evening, everyone sits in front of the TV following the latest count.
Whatever the result, completing an election peacefully is an important value of a democratic society.
